finalText:
**Migration is done.** 12 files still used `db.query`, 36 call sites in all.

Each one now reads `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the files migrated earlier.

Two things I left alone on purpose. `cache.query` is the cache, not the database. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is vendored code that gets replaced on upgrade.

`node verify.js` passes.
